titulo.estudio: Un article spécialisé : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: A specialist article: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Work out specialist terms from their context and follow the explanation of a mechanism. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Ces milieux retiennent l'eau lors des pluies fortes et ralentissent son écoulement vers les cours d'eau.
frases.alumno: These environments hold back water during heavy rain and slow its flow towards the watercourses.

frases.estudio: Ils offrent également un habitat à des espèces qui ne trouvent plus assez de nourriture dans les champs cultivés.
frases.alumno: They also provide a habitat for species that no longer find enough food in farmland.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Work out specialist terms from their context and follow the explanation of a mechanism. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: definitions, examples and rephrasing can clarify technical vocabulary without translating every word. In this passage, «habitat» means «habitat».
